title: Ten Steps By Day, ELEVEN At Night 🪜
description:
Our stairs have ten steps by day. After midnight you'll count eleven, and at two in the morning they creak ten times with nobody on them.

My dad has one house rule. Everyone's upstairs by ten, and nobody touches the stairs after. So one night I waited behind my door with a flashlight to see which step was new.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
